sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: New table-style setting `sa_default_hidden_columns` (Page Type → comma-separated, quoted column list) lets you pre-hide columns the first time a given pageType's table renders, without touching the 👁️ Visible popup manually. Applied once per pageType by seeding the existing per-pageType column-visibility GM storage before the popup is built — a column you later re-check yourself is remembered and never re-hidden. Ships with one default: `release-tracks` → `"ARs"`, so the ARs column starts collapsed/hidden on release-tracks pages instead of visible by default.
